title: Auto-inject $expand for lookup/master_detail fields in all data-fetching plugins
body:
All data views display raw foreign-key IDs for lookup/master_detail fields because the API requests never include `$expand`. This adds automatic `$expand` injection by scanning schema field metadata before each fetch across all 10 data-fetching plugins.

### Core utility

New `buildExpandFields()` in `@object-ui/core` — extracts lookup/master_detail field names from schema, optionally scoped to visible columns:

```ts
import { buildExpandFields } from '@object-ui/core';

const fields = {
  name: { type: 'text' },
  account: { type: 'lookup', reference_to: 'accounts' },
  parent: { type: 'master_detail', reference_to: 'contacts' },
};

buildExpandFields(fields);                    // → ['account', 'parent']
buildExpandFields(fields, ['name', 'account']); // → ['account']
```

### Integration points

All 10 data-fetching plugins now auto-inject `$expand`:

- **ListView** — memoizes expand fields from `objectDef`, injects into `dataSource.find()` params. Covers all sub-views when rendered through ListView.
- **ObjectGrid** — computes from `resolvedSchema.fields` after schema resolution, scoped to configured columns.
- **ObjectKanban** — computes from `objectDef.fields` in standalone fetch path.
- **ObjectCalendar** — computes from `objectSchema.fields`, injected in standalone fetch path.
- **ObjectGantt** — computes from `objectSchema.fields`, injected in standalone fetch path.
- **ObjectMap** — computes from `objectSchema.fields`, injected in standalone fetch path.
- **ObjectView** — computes from `objectSchema.fields`, injected in standalone fetch path.
- **ObjectAgGrid** — computes from `objectSchema.fields` (already waits for schema before fetch).
- **ObjectGallery** — newly added schema fetch via `getObjectSchema()` + `$expand` injection.
- **ObjectTimeline** — newly added schema fetch via `getObjectSchema()` + `$expand` injection.

All plugins inject `$expand` only when lookup fields are detected; no-op when schema has none. Backends that don't support `$expand` ignore the param — existing fallback (display raw ID) preserved. The `$expand` format (`string[]`) is compatible with multi-level nesting paths (e.g. `'account.owner'`); the objectql backend handles recursive expansion.

### Tests

14 unit tests covering: field type detection, column scoping, mixed column formats, null/malformed inputs. 1031 existing plugin tests verified passing across all affected components.

> <issue_description>## 任务背景
> 在 ObjectUI 的 Grid/List/Kanban 等数据视图中，遇到 lookup/master_detail 字段为动态引用时，往往无法显示 label，只能显示 ID。即使 renderer 层已修复，如 LookupCellRenderer 可用 options 或对象自动 resolve，但 API 返回的数据若没有展开（expand），仍会出现原始 ID。
> 
> ## 任务目标
> 1. 前端自动梳理 schema，识别所有 type: 'lookup' 与 type: 'master_detail' 字段
> 2. 在请求 data 时，自动将这些字段名作为 $expand 注入到 QueryParams
> 3. 若 columns 为 ListColumn[] 显式配置，也需兼容其 dynamic lookup 需求
> 4. 必须和 objectql 后端的 expand 实现协同，允许多级嵌套
> 5. 保留现有 fallback（不支持 expand 时降级显示 ID）
> 
> ## 实现理由
> - 只有注入 $expand 后，objectql 才能返回 lookup 对象而不是原始外键
> - 前端统一注���，避免每个 renderer/视图重复处理
> - 符合协议规范，提升体验，与 Airtable 等主流 UX 保持一致
> 
> ## 参考
> - 需同步 objectql engine 完善 expand（见 cross-repo 任务）
